_: Controls under 44x44 per screen, MEASURED (not estimated). Every number is a debt with a name. It may only ever go DOWN: touch-targets.mjs fails if one climbs, and also if one falls without this file being tightened, because that slack is where a regression would hide. Drive a screen to 0 and it stays at 0 for ever.
_started_at: 233 across 21 screens. Shared chrome took it to 128: the theme toggle (28px, every screen), the section switcher (32px, every screen) and the bottom tab bar (a 42px hit area inside a 64px bar, five times per screen). The costing checkboxes and the briefing rows took it to 114, the shared SearchField to 107, and Reports to 101.
_2026_08_30_reports: 107 -> 101, and Reports to zero. Its five segmented tabs were minHeight 40 and its CSV button h-10 — four pixels short, on the most-tapped control of that screen. Financials' opening-balance button went the same way. The audit now NAMES every control it counts, on every run rather than only on a failing screen, which is how these were found: at baseline it used to report a number and nothing else, so the debt was unreadable exactly when the gate was green and there was room to work on it.
_2026_08_30_segmented: 101 -> 54. Every segmented control in the app now meets the 44px floor, copying the recipe Reports proved: products' By Brand/All SKUs/Categories (23px, the smallest control in the app — the stock shadcn TabsList is h-8, which leaves a 25px tab), financials' four P&L tabs (37), competitors' four (35), inventory's five sort pills (32-34), reorder's lens (35) and sales' Orders/Customers (40). Only the BOX grows in every case — the label keeps its text size, which is the distinction the audit already draws between the hit area and the ink. Apple's own segmented control is 32pt tall, so this was checked rather than assumed: the HIG's 44pt is about the tappable area, not the ink, and the rest of this app was moved to 44 on 2026-08-29.
_2026_08_30_customers: 27 -> 0, by exemption rather than by change. The A-Z rail is ONE gesture surface, not 27 discrete targets: ~500px tall, thumb-slide with a HUD, and an empty letter snaps to the nearest section so there are no dead taps. Making its letters 44px each would need 1,188px on a ~700px phone, so the only available 'fix' was deleting the alphabet. Exempted on an explicit data-scrub-rail marker in the markup, never on size or position, so a second rail must opt in deliberately. WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 makes the same allowance where a presentation is essential.
_2026_08_30_h10: 54 -> 48, and Shipments to zero. Every h-10 action button and link measured exactly 40px — four pixels short, on the primary action of its screen: products' New SKU, inventory's and godowns' Transfer, godowns' New, shipments' delete. Products' filter button came back 33x40, narrower than its own w-10, because the flex row was squeezing it: it needed shrink-0 as well as h-11 w-11. Nothing else about these changed.
_2026_08_30_pills: 48 -> 36, and Competitors and Price Lists to zero. Every remaining PILL and free-standing button: promo advisor's Copy post (34), campaigns' Log Campaign (30), the price-gap 'Show N more' (40), price-review's two unit pills and 'Set a price' (32), price lists' 'New list' (36), and Settings' Sign out (42, two pixels short). All were py-1.5/py-2 and are now min-h-11 — the padding rounded the box to whatever the font left, so the height was an accident of the type scale rather than a decision. Text size, colour and horizontal padding are untouched.
_whats_left: 36, and none of it is mechanical any more — each needs a judgement Ali should make, not a four-pixel correction. LIST ROWS at 36-41 (products' 7 brand rows, inventory's 4 expand rows, godowns' 1): these set list DENSITY, so raising them changes how much of a list fits on a phone. THE iOS SWITCHES at 51x31 (settings, x2): that is Apple's exact UISwitch geometry, so the honest fix is a 44px tappable ROW around the switch, like the A-Z rail's exemption reasoning — not a bigger switch. THE FROST SLIDER at 319x32: a range input whose track is drawn by the browser; growing the box may or may not move the track, so it needs measuring, not guessing. THE GENUINELY TINY: financials' 45x6 sparkline bars and 54x18 'Open' links, costing's 12, price-review's 186x18 footnote.
